name: Klaviyo
description: An "AI marketing & service platform for ambitious consumer brands" — an autonomous B2C CRM that unifies customer data with omnichannel marketing automation and AI agents.
best_for: Positioned for consumer/B2C brands, especially e-commerce retailers, plus enterprise brands, restaurants, and wellness companies wanting to consolidate a fragmented marketing tech stack.
features: Composer: AI agent that audits and generates on-brand campaigns/flows from prompts
Customer Agent: AI customer service that autonomously resolves a majority of inquiries
Omnichannel marketing (email, SMS, RCS, WhatsApp, mobile push, social)
Klaviyo Data Platform for unified customer profiles/events
Real-time marketing analytics and omnichannel attribution
Customer Hub & Helpdesk for self-service support

alternatives.name: Mailchimp
alternatives.description: An email and SMS marketing platform combining marketing analytics, automations, and AI tools.
alternatives.best_for: Small to mid-sized businesses wanting an easy-to-use email/SMS marketing tool.

alternatives.name: ActiveCampaign
alternatives.description: An autonomous marketing platform where AI agents handle email, SMS, WhatsApp, and CRM tasks backed by customer data.
alternatives.best_for: Growing businesses that want to automate marketing and sales work and reduce manual effort.
